div.div:
How to read this
Every tier runs in three AZs. Stateless services (general pool) scale with HPA, and Karpenter adds nodes. Each matching engine group has an active instance and a hot standby in another AZ. MSK replicates every message across the three AZs. Aurora and Valkey fail over automatically to a replica in another AZ. Page 2 shows the request and data flow; page 3 shows the cluster platform.
